clues: This city is in Tuscany, in Italy, south east of Florence. It is the chief town of its own part of that land.
Summers here are hot and dry, and winters are mild and wet. November is the wettest month, while July is the driest of the year.
Knights still play an old game of skill on horseback here. The game goes back to the days of the Middle Ages.
Wall art by Piero della Francesca fills a church here. Folk come to see the bright tales he painted on its walls.
A famed cross by Cimabue hangs in one more church here. It is a sign folk link with this town at once.
